name: programmer
description: A Windows dev shell for Claude: files, surgical edits, cmd/PowerShell, shell sessions, WSL jobs, search, transforms and HTTP, in one local binary.
long_description:
Programmer is a single Rust binary that gives Claude a developer shell on this Windows computer: read, write and surgically edit files; run cmd and PowerShell; keep state-carrying shell sessions and live REPL shells; run and poll WSL background jobs; search and grep; archive, diff, hash and bulk-transform files; make HTTP requests; and check ports, processes and the host.

**What it can reach.** It runs locally over stdio as the signed-in Windows user and can read, change and run anything that account can. There is no folder restriction in this release. Commands pass through a built-in, target-aware safety policy (`security_check_cmd` shows the verdict), but you should still read destructive commands before approving them.

**Privacy.** No account, no telemetry, no background service. It sends nothing anywhere on its own; it makes network requests only when Claude calls `http_request` or `port_check`. Its working state (audit log, sessions, screenshots) stays in a `.programmer` folder inside the extension folder.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read file with smart options: search for pattern, range of lines, tail with delta polling, or auto-truncate large files.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write or overwrite a file (creates parent directories); mode=append adds to the end.

tools.name: edit_block
tools.description: Guarded single-file text replacement: exact literal match, fails unless the occurrence count equals expected_replacements.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy file with metadata preservation.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename file.

tools.name: create_dir
tools.description: Create directory recursively.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List directory contents recursively.

tools.name: cmd
tools.description: Execute a Windows Command Prompt command through cmd.exe /C and return output with exit code.

tools.name: powershell
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command and return its output.

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Kill process by PID.

tools.name: list_process
tools.description: List running processes.

tools.name: shortcut
tools.description: List saved shortcuts or run saved/raw command sequences in a session.

tools.name: shell_session
tools.description: State-carrying shell session: remembered cwd and env applied to each fresh command (create, run, cd, env, history, read, destroy).

tools.name: live_shell
tools.description: Long-lived PowerShell or WSL process that holds a REPL and in-memory variables, with incremental reads.

tools.name: search_file
tools.description: Search for files by name or content.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot for troubleshooting; returns the file path and metadata only.

tools.name: system_info
tools.description: Get system info: OS, CPU, memory, disk.

tools.name: clipboard_read
tools.description: Read from clipboard.

tools.name: clipboard_write
tools.description: Write to clipboard.

tools.name: md2docx
tools.description: Convert Markdown file to DOCX via pandoc.

tools.name: wsl_run
tools.description: Run a command in WSL in the foreground; returns an output summary and log path.

tools.name: wsl_bg
tools.description: Launch a WSL background job and return its job_id for polling with wsl_status.

tools.name: wsl_status
tools.description: Check WSL background job status.

tools.name: wsl_log
tools.description: Get full or partial log from a WSL background job.

tools.name: archive_create
tools.description: Create archive (zip, tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2).

tools.name: archive_extract
tools.description: Extract archive (auto-detect format).

tools.name: transform_bulk_rename
tools.description: Regex-based batch rename.

tools.name: transform_sync_dir
tools.description: Sync directories with modes: mirror, update, backup.

tools.name: diff_file
tools.description: Create unified diff between two files.

tools.name: transform_file
tools.description: Apply Python transform to matching files (requires python on PATH).

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Base64 encode or decode a string.

tools.name: json
tools.description: Format (pretty-print) or minify JSON.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert tabular data between formats: csv to json (first row = headers) or json to csv.

tools.name: transform_find_replace
tools.description: Bulk regex-capable find/replace across files, without an occurrence-count guard (use edit_block for guarded single edits).

tools.name: transform_hash_file
tools.description: Compute file checksum (MD5, SHA256).

tools.name: transform_scaffold
tools.description: Generate boilerplate project scaffolding.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search files for pattern, return matching lines with context.

tools.name: file_stats
tools.description: File/directory stats without reading content: node metadata (size, timestamps, readonly, is_dir) plus recursive directory aggregation (file/dir counts, total size).

tools.name: http_request
tools.description: Make an HTTP request; save=<path> downloads the body to disk with resume support.

tools.name: port_check
tools.description: Test TCP connectivity to host:port and report whether it is open and the connect time.

tools.name: security_check_cmd
tools.description: Evaluate a command with the same target-aware policy enforced by command-running tools.

tools.name: security_audit_log
tools.description: View recent security audit log entries.

tools.name: server_health
tools.description: Check running processes by server name without assuming an installation directory.

tools.name: deploy_preflight
tools.description: Pre-deploy checks for a given project path (or the current project).

tools.name: config_validate_mcp
tools.description: Validate an MCP configuration file: structure and that each command exists.

tools.name: plan
tools.description: Analyze a task and return its ingredients: tools needed, dependencies, breadcrumb recommendation.

tools.name: sqlite_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against a SQLite database.

tools.name: registry_read
tools.description: Read Windows registry values from approved locations only.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Per-host capability self-report: git present, WSL present (+distros), shells available, python/pandoc/cargo, state dirs, build profile.
